en.text: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

zhSimplified.text: 我们离别了众人，就开船一直行到哥士。第二天到了罗底，从那里到帕大喇，

zhTraditional.text: 我們離別了眾人，就開船一直行到哥士。第二天到了羅底，從那裏到帕大喇，

en.text: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

zhSimplified.text: 遇见一只船要往腓尼基去，就上船起行。

zhTraditional.text: 遇見一隻船要往腓尼基去，就上船起行。

en.text: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

zhSimplified.text: 望见塞浦路斯，就从南边行过，往叙利亚去，我们就在泰尔上岸，因为船要在那里卸货。

zhTraditional.text: 望見塞浦路斯，就從南邊行過，往敘利亞去，我們就在泰爾上岸，因為船要在那裏卸貨。

en.text: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 找着了门徒，就在那里住了七天。他们被圣灵感动，对保罗说：「不要上耶路撒冷去。」

zhTraditional.text: 找着了門徒，就在那裏住了七天。他們被聖靈感動，對保羅說：「不要上耶路撒冷去。」

en.text: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

zhSimplified.text: 过了这几天，我们就起身前行。他们众人同妻子儿女，送我们到城外，我们都跪在岸上祷告，彼此辞别。

zhTraditional.text: 過了這幾天，我們就起身前行。他們眾人同妻子兒女，送我們到城外，我們都跪在岸上禱告，彼此辭別。

en.text: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

zhSimplified.text: 我们上了船，他们就回家去了。

zhTraditional.text: 我們上了船，他們就回家去了。

en.text: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

zhSimplified.text: 我们从泰尔行尽了水路，来到多利买，就问那里的弟兄安，和他们同住了一天。

zhTraditional.text: 我們從泰爾行盡了水路，來到多利買，就問那裏的弟兄安，和他們同住了一天。

en.text: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

zhSimplified.text: 第二天，我们离开那里，来到凯撒利亚，就进了传福音的腓利家里，和他同住。他是那七个执事里的一个。

zhTraditional.text: 第二天，我們離開那裏，來到凱撒利亞，就進了傳福音的腓利家裏，和他同住。他是那七個執事裏的一個。

en.text: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

zhSimplified.text: 他有四个女儿，都是处女，是说预言的。

zhTraditional.text: 他有四個女兒，都是處女，是說預言的。

en.text: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

zhSimplified.text: 我们在那里多住了几天，有一个先知，名叫亚迦布，从犹太下来，

zhTraditional.text: 我們在那裏多住了幾天，有一個先知，名叫亞迦布，從猶太下來，

en.text: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

zhSimplified.text: 到了我们这里，就拿保罗的腰带捆上自己的手脚，说：「圣灵说：犹太人在耶路撒冷，要如此捆绑这腰带的主人，把他交在外邦人手里。」

zhTraditional.text: 到了我們這裏，就拿保羅的腰帶捆上自己的手腳，說：「聖靈說：猶太人在耶路撒冷，要如此捆綁這腰帶的主人，把他交在外邦人手裏。」

en.text: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 我们和那本地的人听见这话，都苦劝保罗不要上耶路撒冷去。

zhTraditional.text: 我們和那本地的人聽見這話，都苦勸保羅不要上耶路撒冷去。

en.text: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗说：「你们为什么这样痛哭，使我心碎呢？我为主耶稣的名，不但被人捆绑，就是死在耶路撒冷也是愿意的。」

zhTraditional.text: 保羅說：「你們為甚麼這樣痛哭，使我心碎呢？我為主耶穌的名，不但被人捆綁，就是死在耶路撒冷也是願意的。」

en.text: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗既不听劝，我们便住了口，只说：「愿主的旨意成就」，便了。

zhTraditional.text: 保羅既不聽勸，我們便住了口，只說：「願主的旨意成就」，便了。

en.text: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 过了几日，我们收拾行李上耶路撒冷去。

zhTraditional.text: 過了幾日，我們收拾行李上耶路撒冷去。

en.text: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

zhSimplified.text: 有凯撒利亚的几个门徒和我们同去，带我们到一个久为门徒的家里，叫我们与他同住；他名叫拿孙，是塞浦路斯人。

zhTraditional.text: 有凱撒利亞的幾個門徒和我們同去，帶我們到一個久為門徒的家裏，叫我們與他同住；他名叫拿孫，是塞浦路斯人。

en.text: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

zhSimplified.text: 到了耶路撒冷，弟兄们欢欢喜喜地接待我们。

zhTraditional.text: 到了耶路撒冷，弟兄們歡歡喜喜地接待我們。

en.text: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

zhSimplified.text: 第二天，保罗同我们去见雅各；长老们也都在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 第二天，保羅同我們去見雅各；長老們也都在那裏。

en.text: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

zhSimplified.text: 保罗问了他们安，便将 神用他传教，在外邦人中间所行之事，一一地述说了。

zhTraditional.text: 保羅問了他們安，便將上帝用他傳教，在外邦人中間所行之事，一一地述說了。

en.text: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

zhSimplified.text: 他们听见，就归荣耀与 神，对保罗说：「兄台，你看犹太人中信主的有多少万，并且都为律法热心。

zhTraditional.text: 他們聽見，就歸榮耀與上帝，對保羅說：「兄台，你看猶太人中信主的有多少萬，並且都為律法熱心。

en.text: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

zhSimplified.text: 他们听见人说，你教训一切在外邦的犹太人离弃摩西，对他们说，不要给孩子行割礼，也不要遵行条规。

zhTraditional.text: 他們聽見人說，你教訓一切在外邦的猶太人離棄摩西，對他們說，不要給孩子行割禮，也不要遵行條規。

en.text: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

zhSimplified.text: 众人必听见你来了，这可怎么办呢？

zhTraditional.text: 眾人必聽見你來了，這可怎麼辦呢？

en.text: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

zhSimplified.text: 你就照着我们的话行吧！我们这里有四个人，都有愿在身。

zhTraditional.text: 你就照着我們的話行吧！ 我們這裏有四個人，都有願在身。

en.text: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

zhSimplified.text: 你带他们去，与他们一同行洁净的礼，替他们拿出规费，叫他们得以剃头。这样，众人就可知道，先前所听见你的事都是虚的；并可知道，你自己为人，循规蹈矩，遵行律法。

zhTraditional.text: 你帶他們去，與他們一同行潔淨的禮，替他們拿出規費，叫他們得以剃頭。這樣，眾人就可知道，先前所聽見你的事都是虛的；並可知道，你自己為人，循規蹈矩，遵行律法。

en.text: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

zhSimplified.text: 至于信主的外邦人，我们已经写信拟定，叫他们谨忌那祭偶像之物，和血，并勒死的牲畜，与奸淫。」

zhTraditional.text: 至於信主的外邦人，我們已經寫信擬定，叫他們謹忌那祭偶像之物，和血，並勒死的牲畜，與姦淫。」

en.text: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

zhSimplified.text: 于是保罗带着那四个人，第二天与他们一同行了洁净的礼，进了殿，报明洁净的日期满足，只等祭司为他们各人献祭。

zhTraditional.text: 於是保羅帶着那四個人，第二天與他們一同行了潔淨的禮，進了殿，報明潔淨的日期滿足，只等祭司為他們各人獻祭。

en.text: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

zhSimplified.text: 那七日将完，从亚细亚来的犹太人看见保罗在殿里，就耸动了众人，下手拿他，

zhTraditional.text: 那七日將完，從亞細亞來的猶太人看見保羅在殿裏，就聳動了眾人，下手拿他，

en.text: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

zhSimplified.text: 喊叫说：「以色列人来帮助，这就是在各处教训众人糟践我们百姓和律法，并这地方的。他又带着希腊人进殿，污秽了这圣地。」（

zhTraditional.text: 喊叫說：「以色列人來幫助，這就是在各處教訓眾人糟踐我們百姓和律法，並這地方的。他又帶着希臘人進殿，污穢了這聖地。」（

en.text: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

zhSimplified.text: 这话是因他们曾看见以弗所人特罗非摩同保罗在城里，以为保罗带他进了殿。）

zhTraditional.text: 這話是因他們曾看見以弗所人特羅非摩同保羅在城裏，以為保羅帶他進了殿。）

en.text: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

zhSimplified.text: 合城都震动，百姓一齐跑来，拿住保罗，拉他出殿，殿门立刻都关了。

zhTraditional.text: 合城都震動，百姓一齊跑來，拿住保羅，拉他出殿，殿門立刻都關了。

en.text: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

zhSimplified.text: 他们正想要杀他，有人报信给营里的千夫长说：「耶路撒冷合城都乱了。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們正想要殺他，有人報信給營裏的千夫長說：「耶路撒冷合城都亂了。」

en.text: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

zhSimplified.text: 千夫长立时带着兵丁和几个百夫长，跑下去到他们那里。他们见了千夫长和兵丁，就止住不打保罗。

zhTraditional.text: 千夫長立時帶着兵丁和幾個百夫長，跑下去到他們那裏。他們見了千夫長和兵丁，就止住不打保羅。

en.text: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

zhSimplified.text: 于是千夫长上前拿住他，吩咐用两条铁链捆锁；又问他是什么人，做的是什么事。

zhTraditional.text: 於是千夫長上前拿住他，吩咐用兩條鐵鍊捆鎖；又問他是甚麼人，做的是甚麼事。

en.text: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

zhSimplified.text: 众人有喊叫这个的，有喊叫那个的；千夫长因为这样乱嚷，得不着实情，就吩咐人将保罗带进营楼去。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人有喊叫這個的，有喊叫那個的；千夫長因為這樣亂嚷，得不着實情，就吩咐人將保羅帶進營樓去。

en.text: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

zhSimplified.text: 到了台阶上，众人挤得凶猛，兵丁只得将保罗抬起来。

zhTraditional.text: 到了臺階上，眾人擠得兇猛，兵丁只得將保羅抬起來。

en.text: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

zhSimplified.text: 众人跟在后面，喊着说：「除掉他！」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人跟在後面，喊着說：「除掉他！」

en.text: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

zhSimplified.text: 将要带他进营楼，保罗对千夫长说：「我对你说句话可以不可以？」他说：「你懂得希腊话吗？

zhTraditional.text: 將要帶他進營樓，保羅對千夫長說：「我對你說句話可以不可以？」他說：「你懂得希臘話嗎？

en.text: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

zhSimplified.text: 你莫非是从前作乱、带领四千凶徒往旷野去的那埃及人吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 你莫非是從前作亂、帶領四千兇徒往曠野去的那埃及人嗎？」

en.text: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗说：「我本是犹太人，生在基利家的大数，并不是无名小城的人。求你准我对百姓说话。」

zhTraditional.text: 保羅說：「我本是猶太人，生在基利家的大數，並不是無名小城的人。求你准我對百姓說話。」

en.text: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 千夫长准了。保罗就站在台阶上，向百姓摆手，他们都静默无声，保罗便用希伯来话对他们说：

zhTraditional.text: 千夫長准了。保羅就站在臺階上，向百姓擺手，他們都靜默無聲，保羅便用希伯來話對他們說：
